merchantsBeta.title: Join the SOZU Beta Program
merchantsBeta.lead1: Get paid in seconds. Welcome customers. Build the future of payments with us.
merchantsBeta.lead2: We are selecting a small group of businesses to participate in the first stage of SOZU.
merchantsBeta.lead3: A new way to get paid, receive payments, and connect with customers using tools designed for small businesses.
merchantsBeta.lead4: During this stage we will work directly with you to build the product alongside those who use it every day.
merchantsBeta.posIntro: Access the first version of SOZU POS at no cost.
merchantsBeta.posBullet5: View your sales from any device
merchantsBeta.supportBody1: Our team will configure everything with you.
merchantsBeta.supportBody3: We will support you throughout the entire pilot program.
merchantsBeta.customersBody1: SOZU will run adoption campaigns in Santiago to encourage new users to visit participating businesses.
merchantsBeta.customersBody2: Beta merchants will be the first recommended points within the application.
merchantsBeta.foundersIntro: Businesses that participate in this stage will receive permanent benefits at official launch.
merchantsBeta.foundersBullet3: Special terms for future financial tools
merchantsBeta.expectTitle: What do we expect from you?
merchantsBeta.expectBody2: Tell us what works and what doesn't.
merchantsBeta.expectBody3: Help us build a tool designed for real businesses. Your feedback will have a direct impact on the final product.
merchantsBeta.howStep1: Apply with your business — complete the registration form.
merchantsBeta.howStep2: We contact you — we will schedule a brief meeting to understand your operation.
merchantsBeta.howStep3: We set up your account — we install and activate your access.
merchantsBeta.howStep4: You start getting paid — receive payments and test the experience with your customers.
merchantsBeta.howStep5: We build together — we listen to your feedback and continuously improve the product.
merchantsBeta.costFree: Nothing. Participation in the beta program is completely free.
merchantsBeta.costGoal: Our goal is to learn alongside the first businesses that help us build SOZU.
merchantsBeta.closing1: We are building a better way to move money.
merchantsBeta.closing4: Designed together with those who will use it every day.
merchantsBeta.closingCta: Apply with your business and be among the first SOZU merchants.

createOrg.secureTitle: Lock payouts with Face ID, fingerprint, or your device PIN
createOrg.secureBody: You still sign in with Google. When you want extra protection, add biometrics so only you can send money or withdraw to your bank.
createOrg.securePoint1Body: Same Google account you just used. Nothing changes about opening Sozu Pay.
createOrg.securePoint2Body: Face ID, a fingerprint, or your device PIN — on this phone or laptop. We never see it.
createOrg.securePoint3Body: You can turn this on now, or later in Settings. You can start selling either way.
createOrg.secureHowBody: Your phone or laptop will ask for Face ID, a fingerprint, or the device PIN. That stays on your device. After that, payouts and withdrawals ask for it — so a stolen Google login is not enough to move your money.
createOrg.secureHowHint: Skip this and start selling. Come back to Settings → Security whenever you want to lock payouts.
createOrg.merchantIntroTitle: Get paid without the crypto homework
createOrg.merchantIntroBody: Sozu Pay is your store's payment account. Customers pay at the counter, online, or from a link you send. You see the sale, keep the receipt, and the money lands in your store wallet as USDC — digital dollars you can spend or withdraw.
createOrg.merchantHowPosBody: Open POS, type the amount, show the QR. The customer pays; you get the receipt.
createOrg.merchantHowLinkBody: Send a payment link by WhatsApp or Instagram. Same wallet, no extra setup.
createOrg.merchantHowWalletBody: Sales settle in one place. Pay suppliers from it, or withdraw to your bank when you're ready.
createOrg.merchantWalletBody: This is the account that holds what you collect. Sozu Pay opens it for you when you continue — tied to the Google account you just signed in with.
createOrg.merchantWalletPoint1: No seed phrase or extra app. Google is enough to start.
createOrg.merchantWalletPoint2: Customers never see a blockchain address — they scan a QR or tap a link.
createOrg.merchantWalletPoint3: You sign in with Google. Sozu Pay moves the money.
createOrg.merchantWalletHint: This is not a DIY crypto wallet. You don't need to know Stellar to get paid.
